Inside, curled tight, waited a slip of paper. His fingers trembled as he worked the cork free and smoothed the message flat against his knee. He folded the paper into his coat and climbed the stairs to trim the wick once more.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还在沉睡。街灯昏黄，照着空荡的马路，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，留下轻轻的轮胎声。便利店的灯依旧亮着，店员靠在柜台边打盹。远处的高楼只剩零星几扇窗透出微光，像疲惫的眼睛。清洁工推着车，慢慢扫过落叶。天边泛起一丝灰蓝，鸟儿还未醒来。空气清冷而安静，整座城市仿佛屏住呼吸，等待着又一个清晨的到来。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a problem by doing a smaller version of the same problem.\n• It keeps going until it reaches a tiny case so simple it can answer right away.\n• Think of standing between two mirrors: each reflection holds a smaller copy of the same picture."}
